item.title: Taihan Cable Advances Localization of Subsea Cable ROVs
item.summary: Taihan Cable is collaborating with a specialized marine robotics firm to develop the essential equipment needed for the installation of underwater power networks. This initiative aims to decrease dependence on foreign technology for subsea cable projects, improve construction competitiveness, and secure a top position in the global power infrastructure sector.
